name: Tynthal
description: A large city north of One-Eyed Pass, governed by Pilun, with a detachment of Stratians.

timeline.summary: Aesrias recalls killing a stuporous giant, a hydra, and a flock of harpies, taking the harpy heads to Tynthal.
timeline.quote: In the end, I killed them all, of course.

timeline.summary: Aesrias delivers the harpy heads to Governor Pilun in the civic temple, who is crowned and flanked by soldiers.
timeline.quote: I gave the harpy heads to a young attendant

timeline.summary: Pilun accuses Aesrias of stealing from a merchant, and a man in rags falsely testifies; Pilun orders the guards to seize him.
timeline.quote: Guards, it seems we have our criminal.

timeline.summary: Aesrias, tired and suspecting a plot, lets himself be shackled without a fight.
timeline.quote: I let them shackle me and did not fight.

timeline.summary: Aesrias is taken to a coliseum holding pen and realizes he is meant for illegal arena killing.
timeline.quote: I would be sent to kill or die in an arena.

timeline.summary: Aesrias meets the star-skinned nyxborn in the next cell, who knew his mother.
timeline.quote: I've heard your name and I know your mother.

timeline.summary: The nyxborn explains that it was sent to serve the governor but that Pilun no longer serves the true king, and it cannot free itself.
timeline.quote: this governor seems to no longer serve the true king.

timeline.summary: The nyxborn blesses Aesrias with Iroas's power, healing him and strengthening him before he faces sirens; Aesrias asks for candle wax for his ears.
timeline.quote: He touched my shoulders. And I felt better. My wounds healed. I was no longer tired.

timeline.summary: Aesrias is led into the coliseum, where Pilun and a few spectators watch as nine chained sirens are released.
timeline.quote: They all counted together, then released the sirens and ran to the arena's edge.

timeline.summary: Wax-deafened to their songs and protected by the blessing, Aesrias kills several sirens using their own chains.
timeline.quote: When the first siren tried to fly away in a panic, she choked her sister to death.

timeline.summary: Aesrias breaks the chain loop and is carried out of the coliseum and into the countryside by the remaining four sirens.
timeline.quote: I was able to easily break the links and held fast to the sirens.

relations.quote: Tynthal's governor, Pilun, had summoned me to deal with the harpies.
